blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) demonstrated its commitment to reaching communities in need through the turnover of ChariTimba food packs to the Presidential Office for Maritime Concerns (POMC) on Thursday, September 24, 2026, at PCSO Main Office in Mandaluyong City. Representing PCSO, Corporate Planning Department Manager Atty. Anna Liza Inciong led the turnover of the food packs, which were received by Segundino Jubinal, Director III of the POMC. Jubinal expressed appreciation for the assistance, noting that the food packs will be delivered to residents of Brgy. Pag-asa in the Municipality of Kalayaan, Palawan.
